summary: Added first documentation for the `deepseek` module (previously the only registered module with zero doc pages). Created `docs/deepseek/index.md` (module overview covering the direct-API transport, model identifiers, auth via DEEPSEEK_API_KEY, per-level thinking resolution, client-side cost computation with baked pricing table, exports list, and a manual smoke test) and `docs/deepseek/reference.md` (mkdocstrings `::: robotsix_llmio.deepseek`, mirroring docs/openrouter/reference.md). Registered `docs/deepseek/**` in docs/modules.yaml under the deepseek module's paths so the robotsix-modules check stays consistent, added a DeepSeek entry to the module list in docs/index.md, and added DeepSeek nav entries under both the module list and the API Reference section in mkdocs.yml. Verified exports in the doc match the module's `__all__` (DeepseekAPIError, DeepseekModel, DeepseekPricing, DeepseekProvider, ModelPrices, compute_cost, record_deepseek_cost) and the reference.md format matches siblings. The diff was already applied to the working tree; all changes verified present and factually accurate against the source.
updated_memory: Docs layout: docs/ houses per-module subdirs (core/, openrouter/, deepseek/, claude_sdk/, config/, anthropic/, clients/{knowledge,refdocs,self_review}/) each with index.md plus a mkdocstrings reference.md where present (openrouter/, deepseek/, claude_sdk/, core/ have reference.md; anthropic/ ships only index.md). Root has index.md (module list), modules.yaml (canonical module-to-paths taxonomy; deepseek owns src/robotsix_llmio/deepseek/**, tests/deepseek/**, docs/deepseek/**), changelog.md, contributing.md. mkdocs.yml nav mirrors the module list and API Reference. deepseek module __all__: DeepseekAPIError, DeepseekModel, DeepseekPricing, DeepseekProvider, ModelPrices, compute_cost, record_deepseek_cost.
